I am writing to invite nominations of officers for appointment on deputation
to the posts under Central Staffing Scheme(C55) and for the post of Chief
Vigilance Officers (CVOs) in Central Public Sector Enterprises (CP3Es) and other
organizations under various Ministries/Departments. The detailed guidelines to this
effect are given in Appendix-l and Appendix-ll respectively. The details of stations
where posts of CVO are located are indicated at Appendix-lll as well as the list of
services participating under the Central Staffing Scheme is also attached as
Appendix-lV.

2. As you are aware, nominations for both C55 and CVO posts are invited
through a single interface namely SUPREMO portal. This portal also gives option to
officers fo opt for being considered for the Non-CSS posts (ie posts in
PSUfAutonomous Body/Registered Society/Statutory Body etc) for which
vacancies are available from time to time.

3 The online application form is available in the supremo portal
{(https:supreme. nic.inf) and the format of the same is enclosed. Annexure-1 of the
form along with photograph needs to be filled online by the officer. Annexure [1
and IV have to be filled online by the Nodal Officer designated for this purpose by
the Cadre Controlling Authonty (CCA) and forwarded online to DoP&T. It may
however, be noted that only officers belonging to services participating in the
Central Staffing Scheme (Appendix-IV) may apply for CSS. | would request that the
guidelines brought out in Appendix | and Il are sinctly adhered to while forwarding
the applications of officers. The supremo portal for receiving applications for 2026
will be operational only from 1% January 2026.

4. It is observed that the applications of officers, who have applied for the
posts under C55 or that of CVOs or both, are often forwarded for some other posts
without consulting the office of the Establishment Officer. It is, therefore, requested
that the names of officers forwarded for consideration for the above posts may not
be recommended for other posts without consulting this Division.

2 The Government of India has been following a policy of debarring an
officer for five years, if, hefshe fails fo join the Central deputation as per orders of
DaPT either on personal grounds or the refusal of the Cadre to relieve him, It may
be noted that withdrawal of the name of an officer after a panel has been
recommended by the Civil Services Board results in debarment for five years. As
